description: This file defines Express.js routes for tenant-related API endpoints, including CRUD operations, navigation data retrieval, credit summaries, and user usage statistics, with integration to external services and models.

methods.name: router.get('/', ...)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list tenants.

methods.name: router.get('/:id', ...)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a tenant by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/', ...)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new tenant.

methods.name: router.put('/:id', ...)
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a tenant by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id', ...)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a tenant by ID.

methods.name: router.get('/:tenantId/navigation', ...)
methods.description: Retrieves navigation structure (groups, users, projects) for a tenant.

methods.name: router.get('/:tenantId/credits-summary', ...)
methods.description: Provides a summary of tenant credits, usage, and breakdowns.

methods.name: router.get('/:tenantId/users/usage', ...)
methods.description: Provides per-user usage data including costs and session durations.
